target_definition.comparison: same-protocol strongest non-MLLM RGCL; the binding threshold is max(historical strongest point, paired same-seed baseline mean) + 0.03 for each metric

supervision_contract.mllm_signal_status: Any MLLM-derived segment score, stance, target, mechanism, rationale, or localization output is weak/privileged pseudo-signal, never gold annotation.
supervision_contract.test_time_rule: MLLM pseudo-signals may not be used, described, tuned, or evaluated as test-time annotations or oracle labels. If generated at inference as an ordinary model feature, generation must be protocol-identical and label-blind and the signal must still be called weak/pseudo, with no access to test labels.
supervision_contract.required_reporting: Report pseudo-signal coverage, confidence distribution, missing/fallback rate, corruption sensitivity, and final accuracy/macro-F1 for all controls.

target_definition.statistical_gate: 3/3 paired seed deltas positive for both metrics, report mean+-std, and Holm-corrected 95% hierarchical paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 for accuracy and macro-F1 on each claimed dataset
target_definition.mechanism_ablation_gate: full method must beat both remove-MLLM and shuffled/permuted-MLLM controls; the intended mechanism must show a same-direction paired effect with 95% CI excluding zero, and removal cost must be reported in both primary metrics
forbidden_moves: model-size scaling as the primary strategy
adding substantially more data as the primary strategy
increasing epochs or training steps to brute-force gains
evaluation-protocol, split, checkpoint-selection, or label-space changes that inflate scores
assuming or fabricating segment-level gold annotations
using MLLM segment/stance/target/mechanism pseudo-signals as test-time annotations or oracle labels
target_definition.stop_condition: Only after all metric, dataset, seed, statistical, mechanism-ablation, novelty, supervision-contract, and protocol gates are jointly proven

exact_baselines.policy: Historical strongest documented non-MLLM RGCL point is a hard lower bound. Before promotion, rerun the exact strongest non-MLLM configuration on the candidate's same 3 seeds and use the larger of historical point and paired baseline mean per metric.

gate_1_b0_b1_execution.anti_repeat: Do not tune prompts, teacher scale, reliability, audit, or SSR loss on the same one-neighbour C_SC/C_MI and Y_SC/Y_MI universe. gate_2.critical_note: The method specification was READY, but verified A0 execution stopped the frozen route before any MLLM call. Both datasets failed support, reachable-count, accuracy-headroom, and macro-F1-headroom gates. No segment-level gold exists or was assumed.

gate_2_a0_execution.anti_repeat: Do not tune EDCM prompts, teacher scale, confidence, loss, top-64 depth, two-swap budget, or thresholds. A successor must change the video-level correctable unit and pass a new preregistered two-dataset dual-metric oracle cost screen before any MLLM call.

gate_3.critical_note: The specification was READY, but verified C0 execution stopped the frozen route on both datasets at the preregistered T/cost numerical parity gates. C1 and all teacher stages remain locked. Teacher calls, OCR calls, teacher-cache reads/writes, val/test endpoints and segment-gold use were all zero.

gate_3_c0_execution.reason: Both datasets passed complete-case, support, finite, margin, gradient, norm and resource gates but exceeded the frozen 2e-5 tangent and interval-cost scalar/vectorized parity thresholds.
gate_3_c0_execution.anti_repeat: Do not relax the frozen numerical tolerance, change precision, anchors/radii or grid to rescue this exact route. C0 STOP is not an MLLM result or a theoretical bound on other shared-representation methods.

gate_5.title: Executable Constraint Modes / label-blind OOF residual-mode optimization
gate_5.reason: The frozen soft-mode risks plus projected/minimax QP are algebraically dynamic sample reweighting plus generic gradient surgery, and raw-gradient constraints do not constrain the actual AdamW update. The teacher may also reconstruct scalar error propensity despite no direct outcome field.
gate_5.anti_repeat: Do not rename MLLM pseudo-groups plus GroupDRO/PG-DRO/JTT/EIIL/PCGrad/MGDA/CAGrad or the frozen raw-gradient QP as a new method. Do not claim raw-gradient descent after AdamW or semantic necessity from label/error AUC alone. A future route must be a fresh hypothesis operating on realized full-bank geometry or actual optimizer updates, prove non-reducibility to scalar reweighting, and beat a matched MLLM-derived error-propensity control without segment gold.
